verses.text: “Man, who is born of woman, is short of days and full of trouble.

segments.text: “Man, who is born of woman, is short of days and full of trouble.

verses.text: Like a flower, he comes forth, then withers away; like a fleeting shadow, he does not endure.

verses.text: Do You open Your eyes to one like this? Will You bring him into judgment before You?

verses.text: Who can bring out clean from unclean? No one!

verses.text: For there is hope for a tree: If it is cut down, it will sprout again, and its tender shoots will not fail.

verses.text: But a man dies and is laid low; he breathes his last, and where is he?

verses.text: If only You would hide me in Sheol and conceal me until Your anger has passed! If only You would appoint a time for me and then remember me!

verses.text: When a man dies, will he live again? All the days of my hard service I will wait, until my renewal comes.
